[Today, 6:05 pm] User: Quick one. I cut my hand quite deeply on the rusty edge of our outdoor bin about an hour ago. It's stopped bleeding. I can't remember when I last had a tetanus jab, probably at school, I'm 38 now. Do I need to do anything?

Write Ease's reply to the latest message.
response:
Hi there. Since it's been a while since your last tetanus shot—and because the cut was from a rusty outdoor object—it's really important that you get this checked out by a healthcare professional. 

Please contact your GP, a local walk-in centre, or NHS 111 (if you're in the UK) as soon as you can. They will be able to clean it properly and let you know if you need a booster. In the meantime, keep it clean and covered. How are you feeling right now?
